clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around Bea's birth in March 1995, within the following year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents growing distant by November, you with stomach aches missing school by February 1996, your brother in shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother not returning to her job by September. The shifts move from your mother toward distance between your parents, then to you and your brother each, a spread across the household as the new baby settles in.
